items.t: 10-speed automatic valve body failure
items.note: A full transmission replacement costs far more. Ask GM for goodwill help if the car is near warranty.

items.t: Transmission damage can lock the rear wheels (recall)
Power steering and brake assist suddenly reduced
items.job: Diagnose module communication faults; replace brake control module if failed
items.note: Often covered under warranty on these years.

items.t: Brake assist can be lost (recall)
Brake warnings and hard pedal from failed brake control module
Side curtain airbags may be installed wrong (recall)
Airbag warning light may not work correctly (recall)
Daytime running lights stay on with headlights (recall)
Oil leak at the camshaft carrier
items.note: Owners out of warranty report bills in the thousands.

items.t: Check engine light from a failed purge pump
items.note: May be free under GM special coverage on the 2.0L; check your VIN.

items.t: Engine stalls or shuts off while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling; repair fuel, sensor or engine fault
items.note: If the engine has failed internally, replacement costs many thousands; it should be a warranty claim on most of these cars.

items.t: Hesitation, engine flare or harsh shifts when pulling away
items.job: Transmission software update and adapt relearn
items.note: If the valve body is worn, see the valve body repair cost.

items.t: Shudder or flutter when cylinders shut off to save fuel
Squeak or squeal from brake pad wear sensors
items.job: Replace or reposition brake pad wear sensors

items.t: Rear wheels lock up with a bang and flashing 'D'
items.job: Diagnose driveline and apply GM bulletin repair
items.note: Repair depends on what the bulletin finds; ask whether the 10-speed recall applies.

items.t: Overheating warning from a faulty coolant temperature sensor
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $676–$816 for this sensor on the CT4.

items.t: 'No fob detected' and won't start
items.job: Replace body control module and program

items.t: Auto stop/start stops working with battery warning
Driver-assist features unavailable or 'Service Driver Assist'
items.job: Replace and calibrate front camera module

items.t: Weak or no cabin heat
items.job: Diagnose heater; replace blend door actuator if failed
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $176–$250 for a blend door actuator on the CT4.

items.t: Rattle from the starter
Radio and chimes lose sound or audio drains the battery
items.job: Infotainment software update or radio/amplifier replacement

items.t: Electric parking brake keeps setting itself
items.job: Diagnose electric parking brake; replace switch or caliper motor

items.t: Brake light out from water in the tail light
Wavy or distorted windshield
Manual gearbox grinds or won't go into second
items.job: Diagnose manual transmission; repair synchronizers or clutch
items.note: Should be a warranty claim on these years.

items.t: Low oil pressure warning
items.job: Diagnose oil pressure; replace sensor or repair leak
